note: Bit-select assignment targets inside a process - the path where hif-frontend#9 and hif-frontend#23 live - as opposed to bit_select_assign.v, which covers the continuous form and the partial-driver lowering it needs. The whole-vector reset write shares the register with the four per-bit writes, which is what a splitting pass has to reconcile, and q[3] <= q[2] puts a bit-select on both sides so the bits depend on one another. Behavioral rather than plain because the regenerated process is the source verbatim: a reparse confirms nothing here, while a wrong index is silent.
